scope: 104 non-physical sources referenced by the retained v24 effective water snapshot and land polygon-custody report, plus the selected OSM physical land archive. This is not a complete dependency inventory and does not establish source correctness or geographic approval. Overture water shards are checked separately by the physical rerun.
method: Authenticated R2 GET and SHA-256 and byte-count comparison against live Neon source catalog pins; OSM is additionally compared with the local archive and each run sidecar.

osm_land_archive.method: Fresh remote GET streamed and hashed; local ZIP hashed separately; each run sidecar and matching local ZIP member independently hashed. The rasterizer read extracted local sidecars, not the R2 ZIP. SHA-256 collision resistance links the identical ZIP bytes.

v24_local_replacement_geometries.limitation: These preserve used research inputs; their source-construction lineage remains incomplete. The closure is stored as source evidence, not a normalized selected closure decision. No geography was accepted.
v24_local_replacement_geometries.terminal_verification: Both closure endpoints exactly match the respective boundary start coordinates in the retained v24 snapshot. These are partial lineage only.

v24_iceland_ocean_source.limitation: Referenced by the v24 Iceland ocean snapshot; has no explicit source-asset foreign key. This check verifies custody, not geographical authority.

additional_land_report_evidence.scope: 113 additional distinct source records named in the v24 land report. A citation establishes a research reference, not necessarily execution-time use.
additional_land_report_evidence.method: Authenticated R2 GET with SHA-256 and size compared to live Neon catalog

v24_effective_snapshots.limitation: Queryable source evidence, not normalized or accepted decision revisions. Source-construction lineage remains incomplete.
